title: Acute Lower Back Pain with Radiation

patient.name: David Thompson
patient.persona: Retired school teacher living alone, speaks calmly and provides clear answers without volunteering extra information.
patient.openingLine: I’ve got low back pain that started yesterday when I was unloading groceries.

facts.text: The pain started yesterday while I was unloading groceries from my pickup truck.
facts.quote: It started yesterday, I was unloading groceries from my pickup truck when it suddenly started.

facts.text: The pain is in my lower back and feels stabbing.
facts.quote: It feels like it's stabbing just right in my lower back.

facts.text: When I sit completely still, the pain is 2 out of 10.
facts.quote: If I'm sitting, uh completely still like like I am right now, it's a 2 out of 10.

facts.text: The pain gets worse when I move, bend my back, or even cough.
facts.quote: Uh anytime I I move or bend my back or uh even cough it it worsens the pain significantly.

facts.text: The pain has not changed since it started yesterday.
facts.quote: No, it's been this same awful pain this whole time.

facts.text: I also feel the pain going into my right leg as an aching sensation.
facts.quote: I also feel the pain uh into my right leg.

facts.text: I have had back pain over the years, but nothing like this before.
facts.quote: I've had back pain uh over the years, but nothing like this before.
